who: Mabel Collins · Light on the Path, 1886
quote: ...to go to the Hall of Learning is to enter the state in which learning becomes possible. ... For when the disciple is ready the Master is ready also.
meaning: When you are truly ready to learn, the right teacher is ready too.

who: A lama to young Milarepa · tr. Kazi Dawa-Samdup, ed. W. Y. Evans-Wentz, 1928
quote: ...I see quite well that I shall not be able to convert thee. ... he is called Marpa the Translator. Between thee and him there is a karmic connexion... To him thou must go.
meaning: Not every teacher is your teacher. Go to the one meant for you.

who: Rumi · Masnavi I, 1741, tr. R. A. Nicholson, 1926
quote: If they that are thirsty seek water from the world, (yet) water too seeks in the world them that are thirsty.
meaning: You look for the teacher, and the teacher is looking for you too.

who: Swami Vivekananda, on Yoga Sutra 4.3 · Raja Yoga, 1896
quote: The water for irrigation of fields is already in the canal, only shut in by gates. The farmer opens these gates, and the water flows in by itself...
meaning: The power is in you. The right help opens the gate.

quote: He teaches who gives, and he learns who receives. There is no teaching until the pupil is brought into the same state or principle in which you are; a transfusion takes place...
meaning: Real teaching happens only when the student is ready to receive.

quote: Beings with no connection are hard to save.
meaning: Even the kindest teacher cannot help someone who will not listen.

quote: There are three things which are rare indeed and are due to the grace of God, namely, a human birth, the longing for Liberation, and the protecting care of a perfected sage.
meaning: Three rare gifts: being human, wanting freedom, and a true teacher.

who: Socrates · Plato, Theaetetus 150d, tr. H. N. Fowler, 1921
quote: ...those who associate with me, although at first some of them seem very ignorant, yet, as our acquaintance advances, all of them to whom the god is gracious make wonderful progress...
meaning: With the right teacher, slow beginners can make wonderful progress.

who: Yan Hui on Confucius · Analects IX.10, tr. James Legge
quote: The Master, by orderly method, skilfully leads men on. He enlarged my mind with learning, and taught me the restraints of propriety.
meaning: A good teacher leads you step by step, at the right pace.

who: Confucius · Analects XV.7, tr. James Legge
quote: ...The wise err neither in regard to their man nor to their words.
meaning: A wise teacher knows when to speak.
